# Homework 1 - Exploring environmental injustices
Read in data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(tmap)

# read in geodatabase of EJScreen data at the Census Block Group level
ejscreen <- sf::st_read('data/ejscreen/EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb') 

# filter to a state you are interested in
maryland <- ejscreen %>%
  dplyr::filter(ST_ABBREV == "MD") 

# filter to a county you are interested in
baltimore <- ejscreen %>%
  dplyr::filter(CNTY_NAME %in% c("Baltimore City"))

# find the average values for all variables within counties
maryland_counties <- aggregate(maryland, by = list(maryland$CNTY_NAME), FUN = mean)

```

trying to figure out what to plot

```{r}
tm_shape(maryland_counties, layer = "Shape") +
    tm_polygons() +
tm_shape(baltimore) +
    tm_borders(col = "red" )

```
